speaker: Leonard
text: But you really do miss it. Hello to you, too.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Hello, everyone. I brought my new friend, Barry Kripke, home for dinner. That was rock climbing.

speaker: Leonard
text: He passed out. Just hung there like a big suami.

speaker: Sheldon
text: That's where I sit.

speaker: Leonard
text: Ooh, you have a special spot. What kind of wacko are you?

speaker: Howard
text: Oh. How much time you got?

text: You want some Chinese food?

text: Terrific. Got any dental floss?

text: In the bathroom.

text: Be right back. I gotta floss the Indian food out of my teeth if I'm gonna eat Chinese.

text: Oh, yes, I pass out all the time. But it was worth it. I've made substantial progress in bonding with Kripke, which brings me to an awkward moment.

speaker: Leonard
text: What's that?

text: Maintaining five friendships promises to be a Herculean task, so... I'm going to have to let one of you go.

speaker: Penny
text: Calvin, are you okay? Be me, let it be me.

text: Leonard, you are my roommate, my source of transportation, and you help me fold my sheets when they come out of the dryer. You are safe.

speaker: Leonard
text: Can I whistle?

text: Don't be silly. Howard, you do not have a Ph.D. Your cologne is an assault on the senses, and you're not available for video games during the Jewish High Holidays.

text: Guilty as charged, I'm out.

text: No, you two are safe.

text: Come on, what do I have to do?

text: Okay, you know what, I see where this is going. I'm not one of you guys, I'm not a scientist, so just go...

text: Penny, Penny, Penny, everything you're saying is true, but please allow me to continue. Raj, you're out.
